supplements.title: Malnutrition Screening and Nutrition Optimization to Improve Outcomes in Patients With Unresectable Pancreatic Cancer
supplements.summary: Nutritional screening and weekly dietary support may improve quality of life in patients with unresectable pancreatic cancer.

supplements.title: Cepharanthine-mediated PD-L1 autophagic degradation via regulation of TSPO and RILP boosts anti-lung cancer chemo-immunotherapy efficacy.
supplements.summary: Cepharanthine, a plant compound, destroys a lung cancer immune escape protein, enhancing combined chemotherapy and immunotherapy effectiveness.

supplements.title: A sweet danger: the silent link between hyperinsulinemia and gastric cancer.
supplements.summary: High insulin levels increase gastric cancer risk and progression, but metformin treatment significantly reduces cancer recurrence and mortality.

supplements.title: Fucoidan Oligosaccharides from Kjellmaniella crassifolia Ameliorate Ulcerative Colitis by Regulating the TLR4 and NF-κB Signaling Pathway and Modulating Gut Microbiota.
supplements.summary: Fucoidan oligosaccharides from seaweed reduce ulcerative colitis inflammation in mice by calming immune responses and improving gut bacteria.

supplements.title: Design, synthesis, anticancer, antioxidant and computational evaluation of curcumin-benzodiazepine derivatives.
supplements.summary: Researchers created curcumin-benzodiazepine compounds that showed strong anticancer activity against breast cancer cells and antioxidant properties.

supplements.title: Cytotoxic isoflavones from the stem bark of Protea gaguedi.
supplements.summary: Isoflavones from Protea gaguedi plant show strong cytotoxic activity against cervical cancer cells, with potential drug development.

supplements.title: Exploring the chemical composition and anti-cancer potential of Matricaria recutita L. essential oil.
supplements.summary: Chamomile essential oil shows strong cancer-fighting potential against lung, liver, and breast cancer cells in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Green tea polyphenol-iron oxide chitosan nanoparticles modulate gut microbiota and regulate metabolic pathways.
supplements.summary: Green tea nanoparticles improved absorption and altered gut bacteria and liver metabolism in ways that may reduce inflammation and cancer risk.

supplements.title: Modulation of Oxidative Stress, Inflammatory Cytokines, and Mucosal Immunity by Green Synthesized Zinc Nanoparticles in Giardia Infection in Mice.
supplements.summary: Green-synthesized zinc nanoparticles show promise as an alternative treatment for giardia infections, potentially reducing side effects compared to standard drugs.

supplements.title: Exploring the immunomodulatory mechanisms of Astragalus membranaceus in esophageal cancer treatment through network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation.
supplements.summary: Astragalus membranaceus, a traditional herb, targets multiple immune pathways in esophageal cancer through compounds like isorhamnetin, offering new treatment possibilities.

supplements.title: Sorbicillin water fraction from Penicillium flavigenum: Impact on anti-proliferative, apoptotic, and neuroinflammatory responses in glioma model.
supplements.summary: A fungal compound from Penicillium flavigenum reduces brain tumor cell growth and inflammation in glioblastoma models.

supplements.title: Deciphering the anticancer potential of an entomopathogenic fungus, Cordyceps militaris in Dalton's Lymphoma transplanted murine model: a multidimensional approach involving computational methods and in vivo validation.
supplements.summary: Cordyceps militaris mushroom extract reduces Dalton's Lymphoma tumors in mice by triggering apoptosis through DNA damage and cell cycle arrest.

supplements.title: 3'-sialyllactose inhibits the migration and invasion of LPS-induced B16F10 mouse melanoma cells through inactivation of the NF-KB signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: A compound called 3'-sialyllactose reduces melanoma cell migration and invasion by blocking key signaling pathways.

supplements.title: In vitro study of biologically synthesized MgO nanoparticles cytotoxicity in cancer cell lines.
supplements.summary: Magnesium oxide nanoparticles made from plant extract kill esophageal and pancreatic cancer cells effectively in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: The Role of Boron in the Diet and as a Dietary Supplement.
supplements.summary: Boron supplementation may support bone health, reduce inflammation, and potentially aid cancer prevention, though more research is needed.

off_label.title: YK-4-250 mitigates gastrointestinal radiation syndrome and promotes overall survival following partial body radiation injury.
off_label.summary: YK-4-250 drug improves survival and gut function in mice exposed to lethal radiation doses by blocking harmful inflammatory signals and reducing oxidative damage.

off_label.title: AI-driven multi-omics drug repurposing nominates AZD7762 as a multitarget inhibitor of IL22RA1 and FAM221A in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: AI analysis identified AZD7762 as a promising repurposed drug targeting two key genes that drive esophageal squamous cell carcinoma growth.

off_label.title: A sweet danger: the silent link between hyperinsulinemia and gastric cancer.
off_label.summary: High insulin levels increase gastric cancer risk and progression, but metformin treatment significantly reduces cancer recurrence and mortality.

off_label.title: Penfluridol directly targets PDPK1 to suppress AKT1 phosphorylation and stabilize CTR1, inducing cuproptosis in colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: Penfluridol, an antipsychotic drug, kills colorectal cancer cells by blocking a protein that allows copper buildup inside tumor cells.

off_label.title: In silico discovery of novel small-molecule PD-L1 inhibitors through a multi-stage computational workflow integrating machine learning and molecular dynamics.
off_label.summary: Researchers used artificial intelligence and computer simulations to discover a new drug candidate that could block PD-L1 and treat cancer immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Identification of drug repurposing candidates for the treatment of polycystic kidney disease.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified existing drugs that could be repurposed to treat polycystic kidney disease, offering new treatment options for this serious condition.

off_label.title: Repurposing the Neurokinin-1 Receptor Antagonist Aprepitant to Eradicate Relapsed/Refractory Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia via Mitochondria-Driven Necroptosis.
off_label.summary: Aprepitant, an FDA-approved drug, kills drug-resistant acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells by triggering mitochondrial cell death.

off_label.title: Cilostazol inhibits TGF-α-induced migration of hepatocellular carcinoma cells by activating PPARγ.
off_label.summary: Cilostazol blocks hepatocellular carcinoma cell migration by activating PPARγ, which suppresses the AKT signaling pathway.

off_label.title: Metformin use and the risk of liver cancer in a Swedish population-based cohort study.
off_label.summary: Study examined whether metformin use reduces liver cancer risk in Swedish patients with both hepatocellular carcinoma and intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.

off_label.title: Adverse events associated with statin co-use in breast cancer patients: a disproportionality analysis based on the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System.
off_label.summary: Statins used alongside breast cancer treatment may increase adverse events, requiring closer safety monitoring in these patients.

off_label.title: Modulation of Oxidative Stress and Nuclear Factor-κB- Associated Inflammatory Signaling by Rabeprazole in Acetic Acid-Induced Colonic Injury.
off_label.summary: Rabeprazole reduces inflammation and oxidative stress in colon injury models, potentially offering benefits beyond its acid-suppressing effects.

off_label.title: MEK inhibitor cobimetinib increases calreticulin and induces immune modulation in TNBC.
off_label.summary: Cobimetinib, a MEK inhibitor, triggers immune-activating cell death and boosts anti-tumor immunity in triple-negative breast cancer.

off_label.title: Glucagon-Like Peptide 1 Receptor Agonists are Associated With Reduced Risk of Hepatic Encephalopathy in Cirrhosis.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 receptor agonists, used for weight loss, reduced hepatic encephalopathy risk in cirrhosis patients.

off_label.title: Oral propranolol treatment safety in infantile hemangiomas.
off_label.summary: Propranolol safely treats infantile hemangiomas with manageable cardiovascular side effects based on real-world safety data.

off_label.title: A Combination of the Tryptophan Hydroxylase Inhibitor Telotristat with the mTOR Inhibitor Everolimus as an Effective Strategy Against Neuroendocrine Tumors.
off_label.summary: Combining two drugs—telotristat and everolimus—effectively fights neuroendocrine tumors better than either treatment alone.

biomarkers.title: Improving Uptake of Bowel Cancer Screening Among South Asian Adults in Bradford
biomarkers.summary: A culturally tailored bowel cancer screening kit may increase screening uptake among South Asian adults in Bradford.

biomarkers.title: Immunomonitoring After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation for Hematological Malignancies Using Cytokines Profiling and Flow Cytometry
biomarkers.summary: Researchers tracked immune cell function after stem cell transplants for blood cancers to predict infections, relapse, and complications.

biomarkers.title: PARa-aOrtic LymphAdenectomy in Locally Advanced Cervical Cancer
biomarkers.summary: Study tests whether removing para-aortic lymph nodes before chemoradiation improves survival in stage IIIC1 cervical cancer patients.

biomarkers.title: Tissue Procurement Protocol for the Developmental Therapeutics Clinic, National Cancer Institute (NCI)
biomarkers.summary: NCI protocol collects tissue and fluid samples from cancer patients undergoing treatment to support cancer research studies.

biomarkers.title: A Phase 1a/b Study to Investigate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics, and Preliminary Antitumor Activity of BG-C0902, an Antibody-Drug Conjugate Targeting Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) × Mesenchymal-Epithelial Transition (MET), Alone and in Combination With Other Therapeutic Agents in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors
biomarkers.summary: BG-C0902, a new antibody-drug combination targeting two cancer proteins, is being tested for safety and effectiveness in advanced solid tumors.

biomarkers.title: an AI-Driven Four-Tier Invasion Depth Classification for Early Esophageal Cancer
biomarkers.summary: AI system accurately classifies invasion depth in early esophageal cancer using preoperative endoscopic imaging to guide treatment.

biomarkers.title: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase 3 Study to Evaluate Dostarlimab as Sequential Therapy After Chemoradiation in Participants With Locally Advanced Unresected Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
biomarkers.summary: Dostarlimab, given after chemotherapy and radiation, is being tested to improve survival in advanced head and neck cancer patients.

biomarkers.summary: Researchers are testing whether saliva bile acids and pepsin can predict esophageal injury and Barrett's esophagus after sleeve gastrectomy weight loss surgery.

biomarkers.title: A Phase I Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetic Characteristics and Preliminary Efficacy of SI-B036 Bispecific Antibody Injection in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors
biomarkers.summary: A Phase I trial tests SI-B036, a new bispecific antibody, for safety and effectiveness in advanced solid tumor patients.

biomarkers.title: Evaluating an Evidence-Based Family History Screening Program Adapted to Increase Reach and Uptake of Screening for BRCA-Associated Cancers in Rural Public Health Clinics
biomarkers.summary: Study adapts family history screening program to increase BRCA genetic testing uptake among rural women in Georgia public health clinics.

biomarkers.title: A Phase 3, Open-label, Multicenter, Randomized Trial of Trastuzumab Deruxtecan With Bevacizumab Versus Bevacizumab Monotherapy as First-line Maintenance Therapy in HER2-Expressing Ovarian Cancer (DESTINY-Ovarian01/ENGOT-ov89/GEICO144- O/GOG-3112/APGOT-OV13)
biomarkers.summary: A drug combination of trastuzumab deruxtecan and bevacizumab improved outcomes versus bevacizumab alone as first-line maintenance therapy for HER2-expressing advanced ovarian cancer.

biomarkers.title: Follow-up of a French National Cohort of Patients With Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma Requiring Systemic Treatment.
biomarkers.summary: French researchers are tracking long-term outcomes and safety of systemic treatments in advanced skin squamous cell carcinoma patients.

biomarkers.title: A Phase II, Multi-Center Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Volrustomig as Monotherapy or in Combination With Anti-cancer Agents in Participants With Advanced/Metastatic Solid Tumors
biomarkers.summary: A clinical trial is testing volrustomig, alone or combined with other cancer drugs, in patients with advanced solid tumors.

biomarkers.title: A Seamless Phase 1/2 Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Mesothelin-Targeting Autologous Logic-gated Tmod™ CAR T Products, in Heterozygous HLA-A*02 Adults With Recurrent Unresectable, Locally Advanced, or Metastatic Solid Tumors That Express MSLN and Have Lost HLA-A*02 Expression
biomarkers.summary: Study tests engineered CAR T cells targeting mesothelin in solid tumors including colorectal, pancreatic, and lung cancer.

biomarkers.title: A Phase III, Randomized Clinical Trial of Standard Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy +/- Chemotherapy in Patients With 1-3 Positive Nodes, Hormone Receptor-Positive and HER2-Negative Breast Cancer With Recurrence Score (RS) of 25 or Less. biomarkers.summary: Hormone therapy alone works as well as hormone therapy plus chemotherapy for early-stage hormone-responsive breast cancer with low recurrence risk.

trials.summary: Oncologists rarely refer cancer patients to complementary therapies, despite growing patient interest in these alternative treatments.
